decisions.reason: This illustrated release series extends the firm's curation-led label identity and, as a multi-model line, still fits its strategy of broadening distinctive physical offers for collectors.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP matches the firm's specialist reissue capabilities, collector audience, and genre-expansion goal, even if individual titles remain niche.

The multi-disc box set suits the firm's collector-focused customer base and premium physical-media positioning, but its higher production and stock costs make it somewhat more vulnerable than simpler releases.
A general compilation CD is less differentiated than the firm's stronger curated reissues and premium editions, so management would likely reallocate resources to more distinctive products.
